import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/polydiagonal.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','texts/polydiagonal.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(r.stdout)
a=json.loads(Path('inputs/accepted55-routing-context.json').read_text())
print('ROUTING HEADER',{k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='records'})
for x in a['records']:print(x['mathdb_id'],x['title'],x['source_url'])
